title: Wicked Weatherford
author: Wicked Weatherford
description:
Weatherford, Texas has a historic courthouse, the Parker County Peach Festival, and rodeos.
It also has roads that disappear, bells that ring at the wrong time, unsettling varmints everyone pretends not to notice, and tales passed quietly from one generation to the next.
Every episode explores the folklore, history, mysteries, and impossible events surrounding Weatherford and Parker County, Texas. Some of it is documented. Some of it is remembered. Some of it is still happening.
If you don't listen, how will you be prepared?
Around here, the strange isn't coming.
It's always been here.

Whether you're a lifelong observant Jew looking to go deeper, or someone searching for a more alive and personal relationship with Hashem — join us for Emunah Unfiltered

title: The Human Advantage Architecture
author: Dr. Angela Pearson
description:
The Human Advantage Architecture is the companion podcast to The Human Advantage newsletter from OD Synergistics Consulting LLC.


Hosted by AI voices Kai and Maya, each episode takes the newsletter's ideas beyond the page, exploring what artificial intelligence means for leadership, organizational culture, accountability, trust, belonging, and the people experiencing the transformation of work.


From AI maturity and shadow AI to automated hiring, governance, and human judgment, Kai and Maya examine the questions leaders should be asking as AI becomes embedded across organizations.


This is not a podcast about chasing the latest AI tools. It is about building the human architecture required to use them responsibly.


Because organizations will not create lasting advantage simply by adopting AI. The advantage will come from how well their people are prepared to lead, question, govern, and work alongside it.


The Human Advantage Architecture
Where AI transformation meets human leadership.

title: CabCast

description: CabCast is your go-to podcast for timely insights into Virginia agriculture, brought to you by the Accomack and Northampton County Virginia Cooperative Extension offices in partnership with the Virginia Tech Eastern Shore Agricultural Research and Extension Center. Hosted by local Extension agents and researchers, CabCast breaks down critical topics affecting the region’s growers—from pest pressures and weather challenges to crop updates and research-backed solutions.

title: Chief Change Officer™
author: Vince Chan
description:
Change is already working on you. Could you make it work for you?


Chief Change Officer™ is a podcast for people who want to turn change into a breakthrough. It is for those reshaping a career, redirecting an organization, or rebuilding a life.


The show is hosted by Vince Chan, whose first lesson in change came at age four, after a severe arm injury led to surgery, hospitalization, and a long recovery. Since adolescence, she has lived through 20 major transformations across countries, careers, and crises. Before launching the podcast, she spent three decades in global finance and economics, from central banking and credit markets to billion-dollar institutional capital.


That experience taught her that change is never only personal. Markets shift. Institutions decide. Circumstances expand or narrow what people believe is possible. Talent matters, but so do context, timing, and power.


Vince brings together rare minds, black sheep, breakthrough builders, and unconventional champions from around the world. They include scholars who have spent decades studying people and institutions, executives who have carried responsibility through uncertainty, and leaders whose most valuable knowledge was earned beyond the clean lines of a textbook.


Together, they bring what Vince calls hard-earned human intelligence: judgment shaped by consequence and tested by time, trial, and revision.


They do not offer polished success stories or textbook formulas. They reveal what helped when plans collapsed, careers broke open, or life demanded a new direction.


Each conversation turns hard-earned human intelligence into practical judgment: how to understand what is changing, make stronger decisions, and move forward without losing yourself.


Chief Change Officer™ extends Vince’s work beyond markets and institutions into the human side of power and change. How people understand themselves, navigate their environment, and reclaim agency when the old rules no longer hold.


A Global Top 1% podcast and US #1 Careers show, Chief Change Officer™ is built for people who do not want merely to endure change. They want to understand it, use it, and turn it into a breakthrough.


Life is change. The question is whether change works on you, or you learn to make it work for you.

title: VOICES OF GREYSTONES
author: High Tide Studios
description:
Every town has its stories. Some are well known. Most are quietly carried by the people who live there.


Voices of Greystones is a community podcast celebrating the people, memories and moments that make one of Ireland's most remarkable coastal towns unique.


From lifelong locals and newcomers to business owners, artists, volunteers and everyday people with extraordinary experiences, every conversation is a chance to capture a piece of Greystones that might otherwise be lost to time.


Some stories will make you laugh. Others may move you or inspire you. Together, they create a lasting record of the people who make this community what it is.

Recorded at High Tide Studios in the heart of Greystones, every episode begins with a simple coffee and a chat before becoming an honest conversation, preserved for future generations.


Everyone in this town has a story. Some just haven't been asked yet.

Hosted on Acast. See acast.com/privacy for more information.

title: A Simple and Purposeful Home
author: Devon Norris
description:
Purpose needs breathing room.
Home is so much bigger, richer, and simpler than we have been told.
A Simple and Purposeful Home is for the mom who is searching for meaning but exhausted by the world's complicated, anxious solutions — the one who scrolls Instagram and Pinterest and TikTok, overwhelmed and defeated.
I'm Devon — pediatric cardiac nurse turned homeschool mom, grain miller, healthy home consultant, & small business owner. Not here to tell you what to do or make you feel behind. Just honest conversation about what I'm trying, and freedom to take what works for your family.

title: Let's Talk Email
author: Steven Sayo & Jay Oram
description: Welcome to Let's Talk Email, the podcast that dives deep into the world of email. Join hosts Jay Oram and Steven Sayo as they explore everything from the intricacies of email design and coding to the latest platforms, accessibility best practices, and upcoming industry events. Whether you're a seasoned email developer, a marketer looking to boost your campaigns, or simply curious about the technology behind your inbox, Let's Talk Email is your essential guide to navigating the ever-evolving landscape of digital communication. Tune in for expert insights, lively discussions, and a healthy dose of email geekery.

CNA Real Talk is the podcast for Certified Nursing Assistants who want to grow their skills, confidence, and professionalism. Hosted by an experienced CNA, each episode teaches one practical lesson you can use on your very next shift. Through real stories, real workplace situations, and actionable advice, you’ll learn better communication, teamwork, resident care, professionalism, safety, and career success. Whether you’re a new CNA or a seasoned caregiver, this podcast will help you provide exceptional care and become the kind of CNA residents, families, and employers remember.
Real Stories. Real Advice. Real Impact.

Have you ever asked yourself why this keeps happening?
The same relationship. The symptom nobody can explain. The pattern you can't break. The feeling life is stuck on repeat.
The Healer Within is for the woman who's done the therapy, read the books, tried everything, and still can't get to the root of it.
I'm Tracy Fance. For over sixteen years I've helped women find the real root of what's driving their health, their relationships and their repeating patterns.
One idea. One story. 15-20 minutes. Raw and honest.
The healer is already within you. This podcast helps you find her.

author: Mara Kaufman
description: Practical Insights is for people if who are sick of dating and want a serious committed “in-love” relationship. You’ll gain the tools to understand yourself and your relationships more deeply, so you can create the relationship you actually want. Each episode explores the complicated human stuff underneath relationships and turns it into practical insights you can use. Mara’s practical, actionable perspective helps you understand your patterns, your needs, and what you bring to a relationship. You’ll learn how to move toward a long-lasting, committed relationship where you can be fully yourself, have amazing chemistry, want the same kind of life together, get through the rough patches and enjoy each other. Mara took about 5-7 different programs to improve her relationships when she was single, had years of therapy, had multiple serious-committed relationships where they were in love , ending with her husband. And had at least 3 guys propose....seriously, not joking around.

title: The Faith We Share Podcast
author: The Faith We Share Podcast
description: The Faith We Share is a mother-and-daughter journey through God’s Word, reading the Bible together one chapter at a time and sharing honest thoughts, questions and discoveries along the way. Following a chronological reading plan, we explore scripture in a warm, family-friendly way, learning together what God’s Word has to teach us. Whether you’re a parent listening with your child or simply looking for a gentle way for them to explore the Bible, we hope you’ll feel encouraged, inspired and reminded that faith is something beautiful to share.

title: Everything’s Fine (But It’s Not)
author: Ebony In-depth
description: Everything’s Fine (But It’s Not) is a raw, funny, and emotionally honest podcast about the invisible weight people carry while trying to hold life together. Through real conversations about motherhood, relationships, family struggles, healing, emotional burnout, identity, and everyday survival, therapist and mom Ebony gives language to experiences many silently live through. Whether it looks like over-functioning, shutting down, avoiding, overthinking, or overplanning what’s next, this podcast is for the people everyone depends on — often while struggling more than anyone realizes.

title: A Pocket Full of Jewels
author: Julie Marie
description:
Life isn’t always sparkly. Sometimes it’s messy, heavy, confusing, and downright hard—but even in the hardest moments, there are little pieces of beauty worth finding.
Welcome to *A Pocket Full of Jewels* , a podcast hosted by Julie where we talk about real life, real feelings, personal growth, relationships, motherhood, starting over, finding yourself, and those moments when you need a little reminder that you’re stronger than you think.
This isn’t a podcast about having everything figured out. It’s about being honest about the journey—the good days, the bad days, the lessons, the laughter, and the moments that shape who we become.
Think of each episode as a little jewel to put in your pocket and carry with you: a thought, a story, a laugh, or a reminder that might be exactly what you needed to hear that day.
Because sometimes, when life feels heavy, *you just have to find your sparkle again.* ✨💎
Come sit with me, grab your coffee, and let’s find the jewels hidden in everyday life.
*A Pocket Full of Jewels — because there’s always a little sparkle somewhere.*

Life doesn't come with a map. 
But every person we meet leaves behind clues, lessons, and experiences that can help us navigate our own path.
In my podcast, I sit down with leaders, creators, entrepreneurs, and innovators to uncover what they've learned along the way: the successes, the failures, and the decisions that shaped their journey.
Because the goal isn't to follow someone else's map exactly. It's to learn from it, create our own path, and leave a clearer map behind for others.
I'm Larisa, and this is be-teachable.

title: Excellence Becoming
author: K. Joia Houheneka
description: You can build a successful business and still feel that your most important work is ahead of you.  Excellence Becoming is a podcast for entrepreneurs and creators who have already built good lives, but want greater excellence and fresh perspective for what they’re becoming.  Hosted by entrepreneur, coach, publisher, and researcher of human flourishing K. Joia Houheneka, the show explores how excellence is actually formed over a lifetime.  Through conversations with entrepreneurs, creators, and other exemplars, Excellence Becoming goes beneath polished success stories to uncover the formative experiences that shape a life: failures that changed everything, tensions that demanded growth, mistakes that became turning points, and moments of reinvention that transformed success into something deeper.  Because excellence is not a destination.  It is a process of becoming.  Produced by The Worthy Excellence Institute and Gold Standards Media, this podcast is part of a larger exploration of human excellence, self-actualization, entrepreneurship, philosophy, and the conditions that allow human beings to flourish.  If you are building a business in alignment with a worthwhile life, if you believe entrepreneurship can be an expression of who you are rather than simply a way to earn a living, and if you are seeking greater integration between mission, prosperity, contribution, beauty, and legacy, you will feel at home here.  As our gift to listeners, we invite you to receive a complimentary issue of Gold Standards Magazine, where we celebrate the entrepreneurs, creators, and institutions whose work embodies excellence.  Visit www.worthyexcellence.com to explore the wider project.  Claim your complimentary issue at www.goldstandardsmagazine.com.

description:
Freedonomix is a podcast about more than just money—it's about people, purpose, and the stories that shape our lives. Powered by Independent Wealth Partners, this show is for anyone who believes that true financial freedom is about living the life you want, not just the returns you get.
At Freedonomix, we dive into two key areas, Practical Financial Wisdom (tax, investing, wealth strategies etc.) as well as Inspiring Life Stories from friends and clients . 
Whether you're here for the financial insights, the personal stories, or a bit of both, we're glad you've joined us.
Lets get started.

title: Mersey Views
author: Liverpool City Council
description:
Mersey Views is Liverpool City Council's monthly podcast: an honest, plainspoken conversation between the city and the people who run it.

Each episode, council leader Liam Robinson and Dylan Evans take one subject that matters to Liverpool and really get into it, alongside the people living and leading the work. Expect a straight-talking briefing from the leader, a deep dive with guests who know their subject inside out, and Your City, Your Questions, where residents put their questions directly to the leader with no script and no dodging.

This isn't a council broadcast. It's warm, accountable, and confident enough to name what isn't working. From becoming an anti-racist city to backing the next generation, Mersey Views is where Liverpool's real conversations happen.

title: Business Behind the Story
author: Lucas
description:
Business Behind the Story is a documentary podcast about how companies really work — the decisions, strategies, money, competition, and people behind the businesses we know.
Each episode investigates a real company, founder, industry, product, rivalry, collapse, or turnaround. We look beyond headlines and corporate mythology to understand how the business actually made money, what gave it an advantage, which decisions changed its trajectory, and what happened when reality stopped matching the plan.
From technology giants and global brands to startups, retailers, airlines, manufacturers, and spectacular corporate failures, Business Behind the Story explores the forces that build companies — and sometimes destroy them.
Because behind every business is a story about ambition, incentives, timing, capital, competition, and human decisions.

title: BSCP Trailblazers
author: Biomedical Science Careers Program
description:
BSCP's Trailblazers is a podcast series created by and for the Biomedical Science Careers Program Alumni Network to grow, learn from, and connect with each other as we drive meaningful change in our fields. Through candid conversations with alumni, participants, and partners across all ages and stages of their careers, this series aims to showcase diverse career paths, share lessons learned and leadership insight, and highlight the power of community and long-term professional relationships.
This series is a production of BSCP in Boston, Massachusetts.  Founded in 1991 at Harvard Medical School by Dr. Joan Reede, BSCP began on a local scale and attracted students from Massachusetts and across New England. title: Beyond Plastic: where science meets consciousness

description:
"Beyond Plastic: where science meets consciousness" is a journey into the science of living well and the wisdom of living deeply.

Hosted by cardiologist, author, and TEDx speaker Dr. Elie Haddad, the podcast explores the intersection of modern medicine, environmental health, longevity, consciousness, and the deeper questions that shape the way we live.

Drawing from decades in medicine and a lifelong curiosity about the human experience, Dr. Elie moves beyond symptoms and diagnoses to explore the connections between our bodies, our environment, our minds, and our inner lives. Through science, storytelling, and reflection, each series invites us to question what we take for granted, understand the forces shaping our health, and make more conscious choices for ourselves and the world around us.

The journey begins with The Plastic Age, a series tracing the extraordinary rise of plastic from a revolutionary invention to one of the defining materials of our civilization. We’ll explore how it reshaped the way we live, how micro- and nanoplastics found their way into our environment and our bodies, what emerging science is revealing about their impact on human health, and what we can realistically do about it.

Future series will venture into longevity, wellness, consciousness, resilience, purpose, and the evolving science and wisdom of what it means to live a healthier, more meaningful life.

Because living well is about more than adding years to our lives. It is about bringing more life into our years.

description:
Homeland Journey is a documentary interview series from Resource Works that travels into the territories of Indigenous nations across western Canada to let their own leaders tell their own stories.

Each episode is a sit-down conversation, filmed on the land it's about, with hereditary chiefs, elected leaders, and community members who are working to revive their languages and cultures while building real economic self-determination for their people — through forestry, energy, mining, and other resource partnerships that are made on their own terms.

Homeland Journey doesn't come at these conversations as outsiders explaining a community from a distance. It sits down, listens, and lets the people who carry the names, the laws, and the responsibility for their territories speak for themselves — about governance and hereditary law, about the land and what it means to them, about the hard history that got their nations here, and about what self-determination looks like when it's built by the community itself rather than handed to it.

Since launching in 2019, Homeland Journey has featured leaders from nations across British Columbia, and the series continues to expand its reach into new communities across western Canada, one conversation at a time.

New episodes and the full archive are available at resourceworks.com/homelandjourney and on the Homeland Journey YouTube channel.

Hard Bible questions, settled.

Maybe being understood isn't always about finding the perfect words. Sometimes, it's simply about finding someone who understands what your silence is trying to say.

title: The Employer Brief Academy
author: Don Hicks
description:
The Employer Brief Academy is the podcast built for the busy professional who didn't sign up to become an HR expert — but suddenly finds themselves responsible for one of the most complex, high-stakes parts of running a business or organization: having employees.
Whether you're a small business owner, a first-time manager, operating a non-profit, or a seasoned leader stretched thin by the demands of the business, this show meets you where you are. Each episode is designed to be detailed without being dense, engaging without being superficial, and — yes — enjoyable to listen to. Because learning about HR and business compliance doesn't have to feel like a trip to the DMV.
The reality is that managing people comes with a mountain of complexity that nobody fully prepares you for. Employment law, HR policies, hiring and firing, workplace compliance, benefits, performance management — the list is long, the stakes are high, and the consequences of getting it wrong can be serious. For most professionals, that complexity quietly drains time, drains energy, and confidence, that could be spent on the work that excites them. And, all of this drains the resources from the organization and increases costs. 
The Employer Brief Academy exists to change that.
This show is made for a wide range of professionals who share one thing in common: people are part of the equation. That includes business owners and entrepreneurs across for-profit and nonprofit organizations, HR professionals and anyone who has found themselves wearing the HR hat without the title, C-suite executives and senior leaders, and investors who need to understand the operational and people risks inside their portfolio companies — including venture capital and private equity firms. It's also an invaluable resource for the trusted advisors who sit across the table from employers every day — benefits brokers, employment attorneys, bankers, and CPAs — who want to better understand the challenges their clients are navigating and speak their language with confidence.
This show is your trusted resource for cutting through the noise — giving you the knowledge, context, and practical tools to handle people-management and operational challenges with clarity and confidence. The goal isn't to turn you into an HR professional. The goal is to make sure HR never blindsides you again, so you can stop reacting to problems and start focusing on the strategic, rewarding, and growth-oriented parts of your career that made you want to lead in the first place.
Think of it as the briefing you always needed but never had time to find.
This show is released weekly every Wednesday. Find it on Apple Podcast, Spotify, or your preferred podcast app. You can also visit the website at www.theemployerbriefacademy.com.

A daily forensic look at Australian Test Cricket over the next 12 months in which Australia play an unprecedented 21 Test matches.

Dave & Joel will be reporting in on most test playing days at the end of the days play including some episodes from live at Test venues in Mackay, Adelaide, Melbourne & a yet to be determined Test match or 2 from India.


David is a cricketing expert in all of the 3 major formats of the game - front yard, back yard and Club X1  3rds and we feel that gives him the perfect background and experience to comment on all things Australian Test cricket over the next 12 months that will see Australia play 21 Tests in 4 different countries.


Dave's age gives historical context to the pod given he is a few months short of a scrappy half century and he recalls his "cricketing" life began tuning into overnight radio broadcasts of the 1989 Ashes series.


Joel is 11 going on "28" in cricketing maturity years and is a budding young all-rounder, excellent fielder and has a good cricketing head on his shoulders already. His knowledge and experience in both technology and cricket leave his 50 y.o. dinosaur of a father in his wake and we can assure you this pod would not exist without his input.

Hosted by Ally Nitschke, award winning entrepreneur, keynote speaker and author. This podcast is designed for high-performing women who are leading, building, carrying, creating, growing and quietly wondering when they get to exhale.

It is the voice in your ear before the meeting, the reset after the hard conversation, the reminder before you undercharge, the permission slip when you are exhausted, and the steadying hand on your shoulder when you are about to shrink, silence yourself or forget your own power.

You will find episodes on courage, confidence, self-trust, boundaries, money, worth, visibility, leadership, emotional resilience, nervous system regulation, courageous conversations and coming back to your fire.
Think of it as food for the woman behind the title, the business, the role, the responsibilities and the expectations.
Because you are not too much. You are not behind. You are not here to shrink. You are not required to hold everything together at the expense of yourself.
You are allowed to lead, receive, rise, rest, want more, take up space and come home to the woman you are becoming.
Food For The Soul is here to help you return to you, one powerful pep talk at a time.

title: The Psychology Of Selling With Marco Fernandes

description:
Most people who try to sell high-ticket products and services fail at it, and almost none of them understand why. This show fixes that.
Hosted by Marco Fernandes, one of the most experienced closers in the world, this is a no-nonsense podcast about how high-ticket selling actually works. Not theory. Not hype. The real thing, from a man who has spent 39 years doing it and has personally closed over $200 million in sales.
Marco has sold at every level there is. He started as a teenager on the doorsteps and in the boiler rooms, cold-closed the biggest supermarket chains in the country, and built and trained sales teams that generated over $100 million in a single year. He has turned ordinary salespeople into serious earners, transformed entire retail operations, and helped business owners replace weak, inconsistent selling with a system that actually runs. On this show, he hands all of it to you.
Every episode breaks down a real piece of the craft: what closing genuinely is (service, not pressure), the mindset that separates the closers who win from the ones who fold, how to read a buyer and hear what they are really telling you, and the exact 10-step process Marco has used to close deals of every size. 
Along the way he tells the true stories behind the numbers, from record-breaking retail floors to 10 million kilos of fish sold through Tesco, Sainsbury's, Asda and Morrisons off the back of a single cold call.
Whoever you are, there is something here for you. If you run a business and you know your sales are the thing holding your growth back, you will learn what world-class selling looks like and how to get it. If you lead a sales team, you will get a proven method you can train into your people. And if you want to become a high-ticket closer and build a real career, you will learn the craft from someone who has mastered it and trained hundreds of others.
No fluff. No magic bullets. No get-rich-quick nonsense. Just the honest mechanics of how people decide to buy, and how to get genuinely good at helping them do it.
Want to go further? If you would like to talk to our team about transforming the sales in your business, book a free discovery call here: https://tinyurl.com/systemisediscovery
Subscribe now, and let's turn your selling into something that actually performs.

Cash & Honor is for thoughtful people who carry meaningful responsibility and want to carry it well. We explore the difficult decisions that arise when people, money, values, leadership, and long-term consequences intersect.
Through thoughtful conversations with builders, leaders, scholars, public servants, philanthropists, and quiet stewards, we examine the principles, choices, successes, failures, and responsibilities that shape faithful stewardship.
Together, we seek knowledge, develop understanding, cultivate wisdom, and translate what we learn into honorable decisions and practical action.
Each conversation asks not only what happened, but what should a steward learn from it, how should we think about it, and how can we apply that wisdom to the responsibilities placed in our care?
Cash & Honor helps people and institutions care faithfully for what has been entrusted to them and leave every person, institution, and community better than they found it.

description:
Welcome to Harness Up: Bluegrass from the Barn with Haste Draft Horses & Mules — where good bluegrass music, draft horses, mules, and American heritage come together.

Bluegrass music has always had a special place in our hearts, and so has the traditional way of life built around working horses and mules. On this show, we’re bringing those worlds together and sharing some of the music, stories, people, and traditions that continue to keep this way of life alive.

From bluegrass and bluegrass gospel to draft horses working the fields, mule teams traveling country roads, horse-drawn wagons, farming, teamster traditions, and rural Appalachian life, every episode is about slowing things down and enjoying something real.

You’ll hear great music and see the kind of horsepower that helped build America — along with stories about faith, family, hard work, friendship, and preserving the traditions handed down through generations.

Whether you grew up around draft horses and mules, love bluegrass music, or simply appreciate rural America and the old ways, we hope you'll pull up a chair and stay awhile.

🎙️ Harness Up: Bluegrass & Horsepower
🐴 Presented by Haste Draft Horses & Mules

Honesty • Integrity • Our Legacy

Subscribe and join us as we keep the horses working, the strings picking, and the traditions alive.

title: The Imagination Economy
author: Alexander Gorny
description:
When machines can make almost anything, the question is no longer what can we build? — it's what is worth building? The Imagination Economy is a podcast about the great migration of value: from execution to imagination, from making things to knowing what should be made.

Each episode takes one idea from the front line of that shift — the collapse of the cost of making, the new scarcity of clear intent, the craft of directing machines, taste as a trainable skill, and the environments where good work actually happens — and follows it until it becomes useful.

Hosted by Alexander Gorny — founder, engineer, and lifelong builder of places where people want to be.

True to its subject, this show is one half human, one half machine: AI helps produce it; a human decides what's worth making, shapes it, and answers for every word.

Somewhere after fifty, too many people start to feel invisible — talked past, marketed at, and rarely truly heard. Vibrant Second Act exists to change that.
What do people over fifty really need to live well? Not the trends pushed on them — what actually works for them.
Each episode, host Yolanda sits down with the voices empowering life after fifty — community leaders, founders, experts, and changemakers who know this generation best. From wellness programs and travel clubs to authors, advocates, and trusted professionals, these are the people who hear what this generation is truly asking for — what makes them feel alive, and what it actually takes to thrive on their own terms.
The result is a roundtable of real insight from the people closest to this vibrant generation — conversations about wellbeing, visibility, community, and living well in your second act.
Because after fifty, you're not fading. You're just getting started — seen, heard, and thriving.
Not just in appearance—but in energy, joy, and the way she sees herself.
The Radiance Effect is a podcast for women over 50 who are ready to reconnect with the woman they’ve become—and rediscover the glow that’s still within.
I’m Yolanda Russo, holistic self-care specialist and founder of the Beauty On Command Method. And I’m here to guide you with natural, non-invasive tools that support your skin, your mind, and your spirit.
Because the truth is—your face doesn’t just age from time.
It reflects your thoughts, your beliefs, your daily habits, and how much of yourself you still recognize.
And when you shift those things? Your glow returns. Not through products or procedures—but through presence.
Each week, you’ll get science-backed insights and soul-honoring practices to help you feel more energized, confident, and naturally radiant—without having to chase youth or hide who you are.
If you're ready to age with intention—and create a beauty that actually feels like you—this is where we begin.

description:
Welcome to Own Yourself, a podcast about waking up to who you really are.
Hello everyone, I'm Scott Snyder, a father, and someone who spent decades building a career in corporate America. On the outside, everything looked the way it was "supposed to", but somewhere along the way, I started noticing the parts of my life that felt disconnected from something deeper. That's when everything began to shift in my life.
This podcast is the story of that shift. Episode by episode, I'll be sharing the moments, signs, and realizations that led me to a spiritual awakening I never expected. The healing that's come from finally listening to it. We'll talk about various scriptures, other spiritual traditions and stories, and we'll talk honestly about what it looks like to rebuild your life around purpose instead of just routine.
This isn't about having all the answers. It's about being willing to look inward, ask harder questions, and trust that there's more to life than the version we're handed by default. If you're someone who's felt that quiet pull toward something more, whether you're deep in your career, raising a family, or just sensing that something in you is ready to change. Recorded in a relaxed, late-night atmosphere, these are honest, unfiltered conversations with the people shaping the world of weather. Hosted by Thomas Lambert (a Christian school superintendent) and his wife Rachael (a homeschooling mother of three), the show is built on the simple conviction: God gave parents the responsibility for educating their children, and it is a job they must take seriously.
Each week, Thomas and Rachael sit down to talk about what it means to educate a child well. They have conversations with students from every kind of schooling model, parents who've made intentional (and sometimes costly) choices, and school leaders who are partnering with parents and changing the landscape of Christian education.

title: Shed Talk with Kevin Halliday
author: Kevin Halliday
description:
Welcome to "Shed Talk with Kevin Halliday," where we embark on a riveting journey through the life and wisdom of a true force of nature. Kevin Halliday's story is a testament to the boundless potential of the human spirit, and in this podcast, he takes us on a remarkable adventure filled with inspiration, entrepreneurship, and the pursuit of excellence.


Kevin's journey is anything but ordinary. He didn't follow a linear path to success; he carved his own way through the business world, leaving a trail of innovation and achievement in his wake. It all began with his Calgary-based brick-and-mortar company, Spindle, Stairs & Railings. From crafting custom railings to undertaking ambitious commercial projects, Kevin's business became synonymous with quality and craftsmanship.

But Kevin is more than just a successful entrepreneur; he's a multifaceted individual with a passion for exploration and a knack for seizing opportunities. He's an author, with his latest publication, "The Art of Spindle, Stairs & Railings," showcasing his expertise and creative flair. Kevin is also an investor, backing ventures like Brix + Barrel and the Rooftop YYC, two thriving establishments in Calgary's vibrant dining scene. In recognition of his outstanding contributions, he was named one of the "Top 40 Under 40" and earned a spot as an Entrepreneur of the Year finalist in 2010.


Now, let's dive into what makes "Shed Talks with Kevin Halliday" an unmissable podcast:


1. Unparalleled Insights: In each episode, Kevin invites guests to join him in the shed, where they engage in candid conversations that transcend the ordinary. These discussions are a treasure trove of insights, revelations, and thought-provoking ideas that will expand your horizons.

2. The Curiosity Quotient: Kevin Halliday is a firm believer in the power of curiosity. He challenges you to ask yourself, "When was the last time you had curiosity in your head?" Shed Talk encourages you to embrace curiosity, sparking the creative flames within you and inspiring you to explore uncharted territory.

3. Breaking Barriers: Just as Kevin diversified his career from Spindle, Stairs & Railings to investments in dining and beyond, Shed Talk breaks through conventional boundaries. This podcast transcends industries and topics, diving headfirst into the unknown, the intriguing, and the transformative.

4. The Things You Know You Don't Know: Shed Talk delves into those enigmatic areas of knowledge—the things you know you don't know. Kevin Halliday is your guide on this intellectual journey, unraveling mysteries, and uncovering hidden gems of wisdom.

5. A Force of Nature: Kevin Halliday's life is a testament to resilience, adaptability, and relentless pursuit of excellence. Whether it's mastering the art of business, investing in thriving ventures, or conquering bodybuilding to win a Gold Medal in Master's Men's Bodybuilding, Kevin embodies the spirit of venturing beyond boundaries.

6. Great Conversations: At its heart, "Shed Talk with Kevin Halliday" is an interview show, a place where great conversations come to life. Kevin's guests bring their unique perspectives and experiences to the shed, creating dialogues that are both enlightening and captivating.

Join us on this exhilarating ride as we explore the extraordinary life and wisdom of Kevin Halliday. "Shed Talk with Kevin Halliday" isn't just a podcast; it's an invitation to unleash your curiosity, challenge the status quo, and pursue excellence in every aspect of your life.

Remember, "you don't know what you know till you know." And with Shed Talk, you're about to discover a world of knowledge, inspiration, and limitless possibilities.

Whether you're navigating retirement or life after a long career, a career change, an empty nest, loss, changing relationships, a long-delayed dream, or simply hearing that little voice asking, “Now what?”—you belong here.

Because retirement from a career doesn’t mean retirement from purpose, curiosity, creativity, or possibility.

title: Tremor & Parkinson's Surgery Explained with Dr. Wu
author: Chengyuan
description:
Parkinson's meds stopped working like they used to? Tremor making it hard to write, eat, or hold a cup steady? You're not stuck choosing between "wait it out" and "risky brain surgery." 


Dr. Chengyuan Wu is a board certified neurosurgeon who performs single-day, asleep, robot-assisted deep brain stimulation (DBS) for Parkinson's disease and essential tremor, plus incisionless focused ultrasound for tremor and surgery for drug-resistant epilepsy. 


After 2,500+ surgeries, he breaks down what DBS actually involves, who qualifies, what recovery looks like, and why modern DBS carries a lower 30-day complication rate than a hip or knee replacement. 


No scare tactics, no "last resort" thinking. Just clear answers so you can make an informed choice about getting your function back. New episodes on Parkinson's, tremor, and epilepsy surgery weekly.

title: No Plan Survives
author: Benjie Hughes & Mike Carpenter
description:
No Plan Survives is about what happens when our business vision crashes into our business reality – and the new things we create as a result.

This is a limited series: Two entrepreneurs, five days, five topics. Each day we each bring one story from our business journeys, told in three acts:

·         What was your plan?

·         How did reality wreck it?

·         What was born as a result?


Then we interrogate those stories – and each other.


This is a business show that feels more “beer at five” than “Monday morning coffee.” You might hear our tips and frameworks, but it’s not about the frameworks. It’s about what happens when theory crashes into practice – and transforms.


And we get transformed, too.


Hosts:

·         Benjie Hughes is the founder of Hopeless Marketing and a classic “Act 1” builder: In his 20s he started a music business from scratch, grew it, scaled it, exited it. Now he’s in his 40s and starting from scratch again.

·         Mike Carpenter is the owner and CEO at RH Adhesives and a classic “Act 2” builder: He took over an existing manufacturer with a 75-year legacy and then doubled its business. Now he’s building software  tools that might just find a market beyond his own shop’s needs.


They say no plan survives first contact with the enemy. That’s true in all this week’s topics: Vision, revenue, marketing, data and uncertainty.


But it’s also true that when plans die, new things rise up to take their place.


Find and follow Mike and Benjie at noplan.show.

Join ThruDark Co-Founder and former UK Special Forces Operator Anthony 'Staz' Stazicker CGC as he joins a host of inspiring individuals for a hike, using the power of the great outdoors to get people talking about the things that matter.


About ThruDark


ThruDark is a British high-performance clothing brand founded by former UK Special Forces operators Anthony "Staz" Stazicker CGC and Louis Tinsley. Between them, they spent 27 years in the British military, 18 of those in the Special Boat Service, working as snipers, demolition experts and surveillance specialists. ThruDark launched in May 2018 at Bremont's London HQ, with a launch film narrated by actor Tom Hardy. Its first product, a bespoke Summit Suit, was worn for the fastest ascent of the world's 14 highest peaks and later on the summit of Everest. In May 2025, Staz completed a fastest known time on Mission: Everest, travelling from London to the summit and back in seven days, a world first. Every product since has been designed, developed and tested personally by its founders.



"Endeavour Through Adversity."

Hosted by Elumenate Media founder Kelly Dillon, the podcast moves beneath the rendered surface of reality into the architecture that exists before events, perception, physical conditions, and lived experience become recognizable. Eternal Flame Physics examines structure, fields, pressure, pathways, trajectories, perception, the physical body, anomalous activity, time, continuity, environments, and the larger external architecture humanity is living within.

This is not New Age, spiritual, metaphysical, religious, or another belief system or paradigm. Eternal Flame Physics is anti-paradigm. It strips away mythology, symbolism, inherited explanations, and render-based interpretations in order to expose the mechanics underneath them. The experience is separated from the story built around it. The perception is separated from the structure producing it. The rendered event becomes evidence rather than the beginning of the explanation.

The work also maintains the foundational distinction between the Eternal and the external: the Eternal is original and unmoving; the external is movement-based architecture. Physical reality is render within that larger external condition, not the totality or source of reality itself.

Episodes move freely through the body of work rather than following a fixed syllabus. One subject, one question, one mechanic—and then the structure is followed wherever it leads.

No video. No visual performance. Just voice, Flame tone, and Eternal Flame Physics spoken in real time.

title: INVISIBLE LOSS | DNA Test, Secrets, Father, Who Am I, Acceptance, Intrusive Thoughts
author: latekiabush
description:
Have you ever discovered a truth that made you question everything about your life?

Have you ever felt like the ground beneath you shifted… but everyone around you kept saying, “nothing has changed”?

Do you find yourself asking:
 Who am I now?
 Where do I belong?
 Was any of it real?

Have you learned that the man who raised you is not your biological father… and now you’re carrying a kind of pain you don’t even have words for?

A quiet grief.
 An identity you can’t quite hold onto.
 A story that no longer fits.

And somehow… you’re still expected to cook dinner, answer texts, show up for your kids, and act like your entire identity didn’t just get flipped upside down.

(Meanwhile, inside… it’s giving fire, tornado, hailstorm, chaos, and who even am I all at the same time.)

If this is you—you’re not imagining it.
 And you’re definitely not alone.

This is Invisible Loss.

What you’re really wanting (even if you haven’t said it out loud):

You want to know the truth… fully.
 You want to feel acknowledged and accepted.
 You want to see yourself in someone—to finally recognize where you come from.
 You want to feel whole again.

And more than anything…

You want peace.
 Not perfect answers.
 Not a perfectly tied-up story.

Just… peace in your own mind and body again.

What you’ll find here:

This podcast is a space where your experience is finally named—and where you’re not told to “just move on.”

We talk about:

  • The emotional impact of DNA discoveries and hidden family truths
  • The loss of a father you still love
  • The weight of secrets, silence, and betrayal
  • Intrusive thoughts and identity confusion
  • Feeling like a stranger in your own life

But we also move toward something:

Here, you’ll learn how to:

  • Reclaim your identity—even when your story has changed
  • Process the grief that no one else sees
  • Quiet the mental spiral and intrusive thoughts
    • Find peace without needing every answer
    • Reconnect with yourself—your voice, your truth, your sense of belonging

    Because healing doesn’t come from pretending it didn’t happen…
     it comes from finally facing what was hidden—and choosing yourself anyway.

    I’m Latekia Bush — a mother and woman who once believed I knew exactly where I came from… until I didn’t.

    Like many of you, I discovered that the man who raised me was not my biological father. And in that moment, everything shifted. My identity, my past, how I saw myself—everything.

    I tried to move on like nothing changed.
     I searched for answers outside of myself.
     I wanted closure… clarity… something that would make it all make sense.

    But that didn’t bring me peace.

    What did?

    Allowing myself to feel the loss.
     To name what was true.
     To stop minimizing the pain just because others couldn’t see it.

    And then… something harder.

    I had to accept my reality.
     Not the version I wished it could be.
     Not the version that made it easier to hold onto what I thought I had…

    But the truth.

    And I had to let it go.

    Not like it didn’t matter—
     but in a way that stopped it from holding me hostage.

    Because peace didn’t come from figuring everything out.

    It came when I stopped fighting what was…
     and allowed myself to live forward anyway.

    And slowly…
     I began rebuilding who I am from the inside out.

    This podcast is for women—often mothers, often “Daddy’s girls”—who grew up believing they had a complete story… only to discover there was more.

    More truth.
     More questions.
     More to heal.

    If you’ve ever felt like an outsider in your own life…
     like something doesn’t quite fit anymore…
     like you’re searching for yourself while still trying to hold everything else together…

    You belong here.

    Because even when the truth changes your story…
     you still get to reclaim who you are becoming.

Full disclaimer: I am not a cowgirl. 
I’m not claiming to be Western. 
I have no cows… 
I have no chickens…
I have no horses… yet.
I just have a slightly concerning obsession with cowboy boots and an even bigger obsession with the Bible.
We’re talking Bible, apologetics, culture, difficult questions and probably a few opinions that are going to ruffle some feathers.
I don’t claim to know everything. 
But I do believe Christianity can stand up to hard questions and Christians shouldn’t be afraid to ask them.
So, boots on, Bibles open.
Let’s get into it. 🤠⚡️

The station's regular cadre of actors - Chet, Dianne, Mary, Eddie, Herbie, and Sophia - have noticed that not everything is running as smoothly as before. Where did the writers go? Who is Richard, the new station manager and why does he seem to know so much about each of them? What are these other stations that have begun to bleed over into WTTN's frequency?


And the coffee in the break room? Well, the coffee is as terrible as ever. Some things never change.


Petit Guignol Productions is an entertainment company that creates original horror audio dramas. "Petit Guignol" comes from the "Grand Guignol," a French theater in the late 1800s and early 1900s that, in addition to bawdy comedies, staged gruesome and shocking plays often ripped from the sensationalist headlines of the day. PGP seeks to provide similar entertainment over the "air waves" of modern media.
